title: Production hardening roadmap for SQS exporter
description: Coordinate reliability, operability, and delivery improvements identified during architecture review.

title: Move SQS polling to background refresh loop
description:
Move SQS polling to background refresh loop

Scope:
- Add refresh scheduler controlled by METRICS_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS (default 15000).
- Refresh all configured queues on startup and periodically afterward.
- Serve /metrics directly from prom-client registry without on-demand AWS calls.
- Prevent overlapping refresh cycles: use recursive setTimeout or a locking mechanism.
- Implement a /ready endpoint that returns 200 only after the initial refresh/discovery cycle completes.
- Implement adaptive backoff or circuit breaker logic to prevent hammering AWS during persistent outages.

Acceptance criteria:
- /metrics response time is independent from current AWS API latency.
- /ready endpoint correctly signals readiness after first successful fetch.
- Startup fails fast with actionable error if initial refresh cannot run.
- Refresh cycles do not overlap if AWS API calls exceed the refresh interval.

title: Add optional FIFO in-flight groups metric
description:
Support FIFO-specific queue visibility with ApproximateNumberOfGroupsWithInflightMessages.

Scope:
- Request FIFO attribute in GetQueueAttributes response.
- Publish sqs_approximate_number_of_groups_with_inflight_messages gauge when available.
- Ensure non-FIFO queues do not produce errors if attribute is missing.

Acceptance criteria:
- FIFO queues expose the additional metric with queueName label.
- Standard queues continue working without extra failures.
- Tests cover both FIFO-present and FIFO-missing responses.

title: Expand automated tests and metric contract coverage
description:
Increase confidence in behavior changes through focused test expansion.

Scope:
- Add tests for config validation failure paths and queue-level partial failures.
- Add contract assertions for exported metric names and label keys.
- Add tests for refresh scheduler lifecycle and concurrency behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- Test suite covers happy path, partial-failure path, and invalid-config path.
- Metric name/label contract tests fail on accidental breaking changes.
- CI passes consistently with the expanded suite.

title: Add CI workflow for tests on push and PR
description:
Introduce baseline CI automation to keep main branch healthy.

Scope:
- Add GitHub Actions workflow running npm ci and npm test.
- Run on push and pull_request events.
- Include Node.js version matrix (18 and 20) and dependency cache.

Acceptance criteria:
- CI job executes automatically on PRs and branch pushes.
- Build fails when tests fail.
- Workflow status is visible in repository checks.

title: Harden container image for production deployments
description:
Provide secure and lightweight container packaging suitable for orchestration platforms.

Scope:
- Add Dockerfile using slim/alpine Node base image.
- Run as non-root user and include /ping healthcheck.
- Minimize image size and include only runtime dependencies.
- Document recommended resource requirements (CPU/memory limits) in README, accounting for queue count scaling.
- Document metric cardinality implications in README (each queue adds ~4 time series) for Prometheus capacity planning.

Acceptance criteria:
- Container starts exporter successfully with env-based config.
- Image runs as non-root by default.
- Healthcheck indicates healthy/unhealthy based on /ping endpoint.
- README includes recommended resource limits and cardinality guidance.

title: Add prefix-based queue discovery with TTL cache
description:
Add prefix-based queue discovery with TTL cache

Scope:
- Support exact queue names and prefix tokens ending in `*` only (e.g. `orders-*`).
- Resolve prefix tokens using `ListQueues` with `QueueNamePrefix` only; no additional glob/regex matching.
- Add `SQS_DISCOVERY_TTL_MS` (default 900000) to cache discovered queue targets.
- Add `SQS_MAX_DISCOVERED_QUEUES` (default 100) as a hard upper bound on discovered queue count to prevent cardinality explosion.
- On startup, log configured tokens, resolved queue list, and unmatched prefixes.
- Warn and continue when a prefix has no matches; do not fail startup solely for no-match prefixes.
- If discovered queue count exceeds SQS_MAX_DISCOVERED_QUEUES, log a warning and stop further discovery for that cycle.
- Keep /metrics and existing queue metrics contract unchanged (`queueName` label).
- Implement Mark-and-Sweep metric eviction to clear stale labels for deleted/un-discovered queues.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prefix tokens ending with `*` resolve via `ListQueues` and exact names continue to work unchanged.
- Discovery cache is reused within TTL and refreshed after TTL expiry.
- Startup logs include final resolved listening set and unmatched prefix warnings.
- No-match prefixes do not crash startup.
- Discovered queue count is capped at SQS_MAX_DISCOVERED_QUEUES with warning on overflow.
- Docs mention conditional `sqs:ListQueues` permission when prefix tokens are used.
- Stale metrics are evicted when a previously discovered queue is no longer returned in the discovery phase.
- README documents cardinality implications (each queue adds ~4 time series) for Prometheus capacity planning.

title: Isolate per-queue failures during refresh
description:
Isolate per-queue failures during refresh

Scope:
- Replace fail-fast queue aggregation with per-queue result handling (e.g., allSettled).
- Add sqs_exporter_queue_up{queueName} gauge with 1/0 health status.
- Log queue-specific failures with queue identity and error reason.
- Implement edge-triggered error logging: only log when a queue transitions from UP to DOWN or DOWN to UP to prevent log flooding.
- Clear or zero out metrics for queues that fail to fetch, to avoid broadcasting stale data (The "Ghost Metric" problem).

Acceptance criteria:
- One failing queue does not force HTTP 500 for /metrics.
- queue_up metric flips to 0 for failed queues and 1 for healthy queues.
- Existing queue backlog gauges continue to publish for healthy queues.
- Log volume does not explode when a queue persistently fails.
- Stale metrics are not reported for queues that are no longer accessible.

Dependencies:
  -> sqs-exporter-oo4.1 (blocks) - Move SQS polling to background refresh loop
  -> sqs-exporter-oo4 (parent-child) - Production hardening roadmap for SQS exporter

Dependents:
  <- sqs-exporter-oo4.11 (blocks) - Expand automated tests and metric contract coverage
  <- sqs-exporter-oo4.9 (blocks) - Add exporter self-observability metrics

title: Add bounded concurrency for queue refresh
description:
Introduce configurable concurrency controls so high queue counts do not overload AWS APIs.

Scope:
- Add SQS_MAX_CONCURRENCY env var with safe default (5).
- Implement bounded map helper for queue refresh workers.
- Validate SQS_MAX_CONCURRENCY as positive integer at startup.

Acceptance criteria:
- Refresh logic uses bounded concurrency instead of unbounded Promise.all.
- Invalid concurrency config causes clear startup validation failure.
- Behavior is covered with tests for limit=1 and limit>1.

title: Cache queue URL lookups to reduce AWS API calls
description:
Reduce repeated GetQueueUrl requests by caching queueName->queueUrl mappings in memory.

Scope:
- Add in-process map for resolved queue URLs.
- Use cache before making GetQueueUrl API request.
- Invalidate or refresh cache entries on queue-not-found style errors.

Acceptance criteria:
- Repeated refresh cycles for same queue names do not repeatedly call GetQueueUrl.
- Cache behavior is transparent to existing metrics output.
- Tests assert cache hit path and fallback behavior.

title: Support SQS_QUEUE_URLS as configuration input
description:
Allow exporter to scrape queues using explicit queue URLs when queue-name lookup is not permitted.

Scope:
- Add optional SQS_QUEUE_URLS env var (comma-separated URLs).
- Support mixed mode with SQS_QUEUES while preventing duplicate targets.
- Validate URL format and derive stable queue label values.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exporter can run with only SQS_QUEUE_URLS configured.
- Invalid URL entries fail startup with clear validation errors.
- Metrics labels remain stable and documented for URL-backed queues.

title: Centralize and harden runtime configuration validation
description:
Centralize and harden runtime configuration validation

Scope:
- Move validation logic from app.js startup sequence into a dedicated configuration module.
- Add strict typing or Joi/Zod-style validation for all inputs (PORT, SQS_QUEUES, AWS_REGION, METRICS_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS).
- Ensure configuration is immutable after startup.
- Update AWS SDK client initialization to use the default credential provider chain (`@aws-sdk/credential-provider-node`) instead of `fromIni`. This ensures automatic handling and rotation of short-lived STS tokens and metadata credentials in environments like EKS/ECS.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exporter crashes immediately on invalid config (e.g., negative port, invalid refresh interval, missing region) before binding to the port.
- Validation logic is easily testable independent of the Express app.
- Code uses the default AWS credential provider chain.

Dependencies:
  -> sqs-exporter-oo4 (parent-child) - Production hardening roadmap for SQS exporter

Dependents:
  <- sqs-exporter-oo4.14 (blocks) - Add prefix-based queue discovery with TTL cache
  <- sqs-exporter-oo4.7 (blocks) - Expose AWS retry and timeout tuning via env vars

title: Expose AWS retry and timeout tuning via env vars
description:
Make AWS client behavior tunable for unstable network environments.

Scope:
- Add SQS_MAX_ATTEMPTS and SQS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS env vars.
- Wire settings into SQSClient configuration and HTTP handler.
- Document defaults and recommended ranges in README/docs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exporter uses configured retry and timeout values when provided.
- Invalid values are rejected at startup.
- Tests verify config plumbing into client creation path.

title: Implement graceful shutdown for signals
description:
Implement graceful shutdown for signals

Scope:
- Capture SIGTERM and SIGINT signals.
- Stop accepting new HTTP requests.
- Shut down the background queue refresh polling interval/timer.
- Ensure the shutdown procedure waits for the currently executing batch of `GetQueueAttributes` promises to settle before exiting the Node.js process (implement a cancellation token or await pending operations).
- Wait for active /metrics requests to complete before fully closing the Express server.
- Force exit with an error code if shutdown takes longer than a configurable timeout (e.g., GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS, default 10s).

Acceptance criteria:
- Sending SIGTERM to the process stops the HTTP listener but allows active requests to drain.
- Background refresh loop is explicitly stopped and does not start new AWS API calls.
- Pending AWS API calls are allowed to complete or timeout safely before process exit.
- Process exits cleanly with code 0 on successful shutdown.
- Process exits with code 1 if the shutdown times out.

Dependencies:
  -> sqs-exporter-oo4.1 (blocks) - Move SQS polling to background refresh loop
  -> sqs-exporter-oo4 (parent-child) - Production hardening roadmap for SQS exporter

Dependents:
  <- sqs-exporter-oo4.13 (blocks) - Harden container image for production deployments

title: Add exporter self-observability metrics
description:
Expose internal exporter health and performance metrics for alerting and debugging.

Scope:
- Add gauges/counters for last successful refresh timestamp, refresh duration, and refresh failures.
- Add per-refresh queue success/failure counts.
- Document suggested alerting queries in docs.

Acceptance criteria:
- New exporter_* metrics appear on /metrics and update each cycle.
- Failed refreshes increment failure counters and preserve timestamp semantics.
- Tests validate metric presence and value transitions.
